task: Research the new features of the iOS 17 on Apple support and check its compatibility with the iPhone 12.
final_answer:
I have completed my research on iOS 17 features from Apple Support. Here's my comprehensive answer:

## iOS 17 Research Summary

**Source:** Apple Support - About iOS 17 Updates (https://support.apple.com/en-us/118723)

### Major New Features in iOS 17

**📞 Phone**
- **Contact Posters** - Customize how you appear on other people's devices when you call
- **Live Voicemail** - See a live transcription as someone leaves a message and pick up the call *(iPhone 12 and later)*

**💬 Messages**
- **Stickers iMessage app** - All your stickers in one place (Live Stickers, Memoji, Animoji, emoji stickers, third-party packs)
- **Live Stickers** - Create stickers by lifting subjects from photos/videos with effects like Shiny, Puffy, Comic, Outline
- **Check In** - Automatically notifies a family member or friend when you arrive at a destination safely *(iPhone 12 and later)*
- **Audio message transcription** - Read audio messages in the moment, listen later

**📹 FaceTime**
- Leave a video or audio message
- FaceTime calls on Apple TV *(iPhone 12 and later)*
- Reactions (3D effects like hearts, balloons)
- Video effects to adjust Portrait mode intensity

**🔋 StandBy**
- Full-screen experience with glanceable information when iPhone is on its side while charging
- Various clock styles
- Photos automatically shuffle through your best shots
- Widgets at a distance

**Additional Categories** (per Apple Support): AirDrop with NameDrop for contact sharing, Keyboard improvements, Safari updates (Profiles, Tab Groups, Private browsing, Passkeys), Passwords & Password AutoFill, Music (SharePlay, Favorites, Apple Music Sing), AirPlay (In-car, hotel room TVs), AirPods (Adaptive Audio, Personalized Volume, Conversational Awareness), Maps (Offline maps), Siri updates, Visual Look Up, Translate with camera, Health (Mental wellbeing, Mood), and Accessibility features (Personal Voice, Live Speech, Point and Speak).

---

### ✅ iPhone 12 Compatibility with iOS 17

**Yes, the iPhone 12 IS fully compatible with iOS 17.**

iOS 17 supports iPhone XR, iPhone XS, iPhone XS Max, iPhone 11 series, **iPhone 12 mini/iPhone 12/iPhone 12 Pro/iPhone 12 Pro Max**, and later models.

**Features specifically requiring iPhone 12 and later:**
- Live Voicemail
- Check In
- FaceTime calls on Apple TV
- StandBy (Note: StandBy is also restricted on iPhone XR/XS due to Always-On Display requirements; iPhone 12 supports it fully)

**Exceptions for iPhone 12:**
- **Adaptive Audio, Personalized Volume, Conversational Awareness** (AirPods features) - require AirPods Pro (2nd generation), not the iPhone model
- **Crash Detection optimizations** - require iPhone 14 and later

The iPhone 12 supports the vast majority of iOS 17 features, with the noted exceptions being device-specific hardware limitations rather than software compatibility issues.
